item.title: U.S. investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
item.description: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

item.title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
item.description: rained on 100 million square feet of building permits, dream wants to disrupt Autodesk with AI.

item.title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
item.description: On Thursday, AI app Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.

item.title: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
item.description: With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure.

item.title: Amazon updates Alexa to help you manage shopping lists and subscriptions and update delivery instructions
item.description: The update allows you to use Alexa to create lists, register them, see what's on them, and add or edit items. You can also manage subscriptions.

item.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
item.description: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

item.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
item.description: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

item.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
item.description: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.

item.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
item.description: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

item.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
item.description: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.

item.title: Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
item.description: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.

item.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
item.description: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.

item.title: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
item.description: Tech leaders are flaunting how out of touch they are when they brag about using AI to connect with their families.

item.title: South Korea’s financial industry hit by fresh wave of cyberattacks
item.description: South Korea’s financial institutions have been hit by another wave of cyberattacks, highlighting the growing risk of AI-driven hacking in Asia.

item.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
item.description: Nvidia just released a free speech-to-text model that can transcribe up to 40 languages, but it only works on recordings, not live audio, so it’s a big step for meeting and medical transcription tools while still leaving real-time use to rivals like ElevenLabs.

item.title: 7 days until TechCrunch Founder Summit: Save up to $100 on your pass before doors open
item.description: In just 7 days, TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston’s SoWa Power Station on November 4. Your chance to save up to $100 on tickets is running out, and the opportunity to learn and connect directly with experienced founders, investors, and startup leaders is almost here.

item.title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
item.description: Massive note conversions reveal the true extent of Amazon's ownership in Anthropic.

item.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
item.description: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.
